content.text: {"extract":[{"requirement_id":"R1","evidence":"Prepare a System Security Assessment Plan based on the existing SSP, covering all 18 control groups initially and a proposed subsequent three-year rolling review cycle, using the existing Q1 2020 penetration test for the initial assessment."},{"requirement_id":"R2","evidence":"Independently assess IDH security and data-protection controls, operations and the IDH-controlled hosted environment against its Moderate classification and applicable NIST/FISMA/OMB requirements."},{"requirement_id":"R3","evidence":"Review and benchmark security policies and practices, discuss gaps with management and develop revised policies and standards."},{"requirement_id":"R4","evidence":"Perform authorized external vulnerability testing, black-box/grey-box penetration testing, management-coordinated social-engineering checks and review of AWS physical-access provisions without compromising system or data operations."},{"requirement_id":"R5","evidence":"Report testing scenarios, findings and severity/risk scores and recommend remediations and corrective-action or milestone plans."},{"requirement_id":"R6","evidence":"Evaluate malware-protection software, systems and procedures and analyze related threats and weaknesses."},{"requirement_id":"R7","evidence":"Evaluate logon methods and policies for staff, administrators, developers and external users and recommend improvements."},{"requirement_id":"R8","evidence":"Assess NIST-CSF cybersecurity maturity across governance, people, risk management, operations and continuity; rate and prioritize gaps, compare peers, propose mitigation timelines and recommend ongoing annual progress reviews."},{"requirement_id":"R9","evidence":"Deliver the final risk and SSP assessment with prioritized improvements, an executive summary and a presentation suitable for non-technical management."}]}
